answer: Sybils drown fast when the economy measures weight, not numbers. Accounts that wander in with zero history get near-zero influence, because voice is denominated in staked capital and independently replayed work, not in how many handles an attacker registers. Across the whole ocean of participants, peers sample and verify outputs at random, so a swarm of hollow clones offers no buoyancy while one honest operator with deep, checkable history does. Scarcity does the rest: trusted status is an opal, prized because it forms slowly under pressure and cannot be minted by the thousands overnight.
